properties.description: tools/reflow2_check.py reads the item layout. Its LINEAGE check becomes: every item changed on the branch carries prev_item_hash equal to that item's hash at the merge-base, and unchanged items are not checked. The whole-file checks and the "one exporting commit per PR" rule (dec:export-once-per-pr, dec:export-serialisation-belongs-to-the-gate) are superseded. The drift and round-trip checks run unchanged over the loaded design. Designed 2026-09-23.
properties.name: The coherence gate reads the item layout and checks lineage per item
